title: A nonzero section with a zero has positive degree on a proper integral curve
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $C$ be an integral scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme] proper over $k$ [def-weil-proper-morphism] of topological Krull dimension one [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], let $\mathcal L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_C$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], and let $s\in\Gamma(C,\mathcal L)$ be a nonzero global section. Then $\deg_k(\mathcal L)\ge0$ [def-pc-degree-line-bundle]. If $s$ vanishes at some point of $C$, that is, if its nonvanishing locus $C_s$ of [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] is not all of $C$, then $\deg_k(\mathcal L)>0$.

proof.text: Let J be the zero ideal of homOfGlobalSection L s. nonzero_section_integral_cartier shows J.IsInvertible. Hom.nonempty_iso_dual_toModules_tensorObj followed by the right unitor identifies L with J.toModules dual. Transport the degree by Modules.degree_congr.

proof.text: Use the general closed-subscheme Euler additivity formula Modules.eulerChar_tensorObj_eq_add from Modules.HilbertPolynomial with N = J.toModules dual. Evaluation J tensor J-dual is O_C. On the finite affine scheme D, affine vanishing kills all positive cohomology of the restricted invertible module N. The existing source finite-scheme lemma Modules.finrankH_zero_eq_finrankΓ_of_isFinite (Curve.RiemannRoch, section FiniteScheme; no smoothness hypothesis) computes h^0(N) as finrankΓ(D). Reduce the Euler finsum to degree zero and subtract chi(O_C) to get degree(L) = finrankΓ(D). This proves the effective-divisor degree calculation directly; it does not apply the smooth-curve-only degree_dual_toModules.

source.place: Tags 0B40 and 0AYY, proofs of lemma-check-invertible-sheaf-trivial and lemma-degree-effective-Cartier-divisor; Tag 0AYT for the finite-scheme dimension calculation.

proof.text: The natural-number rank is nonnegative. If the nonvanishing locus is proper, nonvanishingLocus_eq_compl_support_zeroLocus and IdealSheafData.range_subschemeι imply Nonempty D (otherwise support J is empty and its complement is the whole curve). Choose a point x of D. The germ ring homomorphism Gamma(D,O_D) -> O_D,x has a nontrivial codomain, so RingHom.domain_nontrivial gives a nontrivial coordinate ring. Its finite-dimensional k-vector-space rank is positive by Module.finrank_pos. Cast this inequality to the integers.

from.place: The fibrewise ampleness-to-projectivity argument: positivity on normalized geometric-fibre components is converted to relative ampleness and then to a projective-bundle embedding.
